location_description: Cranford is a township in Union County, New Jersey, located 18 miles (29 km) southwest of Manhattan. As of the 2020 United States Census, the township's population was 23,847.NJ Transit rail service is available at the Cranford station, along the Raritan Valley train line, with service to Newark Penn Station and to Penn Station in Midtown Manhattan via Midtown Direct. It is part of the New York City metropolitan area.
